title: Pod Sentinel
description: Settings for the Pod Sentinel extension.

enable_pod_sentinel_polling.title: Enable Pod Sentinel Polling
enable_pod_sentinel_polling.description: Enable or disable alerts for pending pods in your namespace.

poll_interval.title: Polling Interval
poll_interval.description: Time interval in seconds between each check for pending pods performed by the extension.

grace_period_seconds.title: Grace Period
grace_period_seconds.description: Time in seconds to wait before considering a pending pod as problematic and eligible for notifications.

max_notifications_per_pod.title: Max Notifications Per Pod
max_notifications_per_pod.description: Maximum number of notifications to send for each pod before stopping further alerts. Default is 2, meaning after a pod generated 2 alerts he won't get accounted for further alerts and sentinel will ignore it.
